scope: Avoid repeated directory enumeration for app navigation with an established gallery
change: LoadRequest retains optional precomputed directional neighbour paths; worker uses them directly for speculative cache preload and only falls back to cancellable scan when gallery context is unknown
known_empty_window: Some(empty) disables fallback scan; None preserves unknown-context fallback
controls: Rapid pending request replacement retains exact supplied paths
Known empty window preserved distinctly from None
limitations: No before/after physical UI latency benchmark
Unknown initial folder context may still trigger duplicate background enumeration
Per-neighbour content classification and decoding still perform bounded file I/O
Collection path metadata not included in pixel memory budget
